message: I don't know why his absence still strikes me so. Something about his being so earnest, and so disliked among those MFAs, and the things he'd had to do for the Army -- they all intersect. Something about the weather, maybe: the last time I saw him was when we were having farewell beers together -- him heading for New Mexico, me heading for Massachusetts -- in a Pittsburgh bar, and the weather was hot and humid like it is now.
